DevSecOps Platform Engineer – Enterprise Analytics Services

 Position Summary
 The DevSecOps Platform Engineer enables the Enterprise Analytics Services product squads by designing, securing, automating, and operating the software delivery platform supporting a common code base across cloud-native and customer-managed on-premises deployments.
 Build the Future of Enterprise Analytics
 As part of Qualitrol's AI-Native Product Engineering organization, this role builds the engineering platform behind Specification-Driven Agentic SDLC, embedding security, automation, observability, and deployment portability into every release.
 Mission
 Own the engineering platform enabling CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, DevSecOps, observability, hybrid-cloud deployment, and software supply-chain security across Enterprise Analytics Services.
 Areas of Stewardship
 Design secure CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and/or Azure DevOps.
 Automate deployments for Azure, Azure Arc, Azure Stack Hub, Kubernetes and customer-managed environments.
 Implement SAST, DAST, SBOMs, artifact signing, secrets management and vulnerability management.
 Develop Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, Bicep and Helm.
 Implement OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana and centralized logging.
 Partner with Product Engineers, Architects and QA to improve engineering productivity through AI-enabled automation.
 What You'll Bring
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related discipline.
 5+ years in DevOps, Platform Engineering, SRE or DevSecOps.
 Kubernetes, Docker, Linux, Terraform, Helm, GitHub Actions/Azure DevOps, Python/Bash/PowerShell.
 Experience with Azure/AWS, Azure Arc, Azure Stack Hub and hybrid-cloud deployments.
 Knowledge of Zero Trust, IAM, OAuth2/OIDC, PKI, secure SDLC and industrial cybersecurity.
 Experience with Agile Scrum; SAFe 6.0 preferred.
 Experience using AI tools to automate engineering workflows.
 Engineering Principles
 Automate before repeating.
 Security is a design requirement.
 Observability is a platform capability.
 Design once. Deploy anywhere.
 AI accelerates engineering; accountability remains human.
 Enable product teams through reusable platform capabilities.
 Success Measures
 Automated secure pipelines adopted across all squads.
 Consistent cloud and on-prem deployments.
 Improved release velocity and software quality.
 Improved cybersecurity and compliance posture.
 High platform reliability and developer productivity.
 Why Join Us
 Build the engineering platform powering Qualitrol's next generation of enterprise analytics services and help shape an AI-Native Product Engineering organization.
 #LI-PW1



 Ralliant Corporation Overview 

 

 Ralliant, originally part of Fortive, now stands as a bold, independent public company driving innovation at the forefront of precision technology. At Ralliant we’re building the future, together with those driven to push boundaries, solve complex problems, and leave a lasting mark on the world.
